sample.label_rule: DIRECT = the record subject is a patient-monitoring device, physiological measurement or its engineering/performance, or a regulatory action about one. TRANSFER = other technology with an explicitly stated patient-monitoring purpose. CLINICAL = medical research about clinical care/outcome that merely uses monitoring data. MEDICAL_UNRELATED = medical but not monitoring technology. NON_MEDICAL = not about patients.
sample.labelled_by: single reviewer (REFOUNDATION-004 agent) reading title and, where present, abstract, against the frozen label rule, after the v2 rules were frozen

sampling_frame.inference_limit: Disproportionate stratified sample of one corpus snapshot; estimates rule precision/recall on records like these, not population prevalence.
sampling_frame.method: fixed-seed random draw per stratum, without replacement, excluding the development sample ids

window.note: The evaluator and the product default feed both use 30 days; QA-002 found the development evaluator used 14.
